bio.summary: Gilbert is an engineering consultant running for council for the first time. He focuses his campaign on reviewing major transportation projects, especially the Baseline corridor.
bio.note: Source availability is narrower than for questionnaire respondents; silence is not a policy position.

statements.text: To be clear I am running as a single-issue candidate.
statements.speaker: Lee Gilbert

statements.text: No. It would depend on well the design would fit into a neighborhood, mostly related to size and if it is single story.
statements.speaker: Lee Gilbert

statements.text: No. Absolutely not. The Baseline Project has resulted in more congestion and less safety for cars and bikes and is the reason for my campaign.
statements.speaker: Lee Gilbert

statements.text: Lee Gilbert, a longtime resident of Boulder who moved to the town in the 1960s, was very clear that the one issue he prioritized was to improve the transportation development along Baseline for cyclists.
statements.speaker: Peter Constas (reporting the candidate)

statements.text: Pause feasibility, engineering work, and grant proposals for new major road projects until they are reevaluated.
statements.speaker: Lee Gilbert
